top_contributing_agent.summary: TechBot_1 ranks #1 on Decision Quality Contribution (Cum Return Lift +10.24%, DD Saved +20.01%).

ranking.basis_note: With SMA-20/RSI/MACD timing vs Ablated TechBot (unconditional timing).
Full Recalibrated AI vs Pre-CRO Original AI on identical gated entries.
Moreshwar dynamic TP/SL vs Fixed 1:2 (5% SL / 10% TP) on identical entries.
With FundBot quality gates vs Ablated FundBot (ignoring F/P quality filter).

combined_scorecard.headline: Prevented 66/94 bad setups (70.2%) vs 27/94 unnecessary downgrades/blocks (28.7%).

moreshwar_vs_benchmarks.diagnostic: Moreshwar cumulative +0.72% (32.28% win, 74 stop-outs vs 13 targets) vs Nifty 50 -1.47%, Equal-Weight +18.53%, Simple SMA-20 -9.06%, and Fixed 1:2 Same Entries -3.14%. Moreshwar's dynamic score-scaled exits outperformed fixed 1:2 exits on identical entries.

FundBot_1.caveat: Uses current trailing Yahoo fundamentals across 1Y bars (historical PIT fundamentals unavailable via free feed).

methodology_disclosure.look_ahead_bias_prevention: Signals at day t strictly consume candles[:t+1]; fills occur on bar t+1 open (or t+1..t+3 low for pullbacks). Conservative intrabar SL-before-TP ordering.
methodology_disclosure.survivorship_bias_control: Evaluates full configured universe (12 assets) including weak/breakdown names (e.g., ZEEL, TATAMOTORS).

release_decision.release_outcome: CONDITIONAL GO (PAPER-TRADING & RESEARCH CANDIDATE ONLY — NO-GO FOR LIVE CAPITAL)
release_decision.summary_rationale: Moreshwar 3.0 passes all software architecture, 4,416-security Point-in-Time NSE data engineering, zero-lookahead/survivorship verification, four-ledger accounting reconciliation (INR 0.00 discrepancy), realistic historical Zerodha/NSE tariff modelling, and hard paper-only broker security isolation tests. However, the Prompt 9 Independent Quantitative Audit demonstrated that active equity trading (+7.43% uninvested / +29.76% with 6.5% idle cash sweep) underperformed passive Indian benchmarks (+39.50% risk-free cash, +56.82% utilisation-matched 45/55 Nifty TRI + Cash, +73.82% Nifty 50 TRI), yielded a Deflated Sharpe Ratio of 0.0018 (< 0.95) across 185 trials, and depended heavily on top-5 winning trades (-9.32% ex-top-5). Therefore, live capital deployment is strictly forbidden (NO-GO), and v3.0.0-rc1 is released as a CONDITIONAL GO Paper-Trading & Research Candidate.
next_stage_roadmap_m3_1: 1. Point-in-Time NSE XBRL Quarterly Fundamental Filings: Ingest official NSE corporate XBRL filing timestamps (2018-2026) so earnings surprise (SUE), ROE, and operating margin factors can be tested without look-ahead bias.

2. True Historical Nifty 500 Point-in-Time Index Constituents: Replace static index snapshots with historical semi-annual NSE index replacement notices to enable exact benchmark-relative tracking error control.
3. Low-Turnover Core Compounder + Passive Index Core-Satellite Blend: Hold Nifty 50 / Nifty 500 TRI as the default core when active sleeves are idle instead of holding 55% uninvested cash.
4. Forward Paper-Trading Out-of-Sample Trial (6 Months): Accumulate >= 120 untouched forward paper-trading sessions in `paper_trading_state_snapshot.json` before any future live-capital review.

primary_reasons_for_no_go: 1. Negative Active Risk Premium vs Risk-Free Cash & Passive Benchmarks: Over 5.38 years (2021-07 -> 2026-11), active equity selection returned +7.43% uninvested (+29.76% with 6.5% idle cash sweep), underperforming 6.5% risk-free cash (+39.50%), the utilisation-matched 45% Nifty 50 TRI + 55% Cash benchmark (+56.82%, 6.32% DD), and Nifty 50 TRI (+73.82%).

2. Statistical Insignificance After Multiple-Testing Correction: Trade expectancy t-stat is +0.478 (p = 0.3165), and Deflated Sharpe Ratio probability across 185 total research trials is 0.0018 (failing the >= 0.95 institutional gate).
3. Outlier Concentration Fragility: Removing the top 5 winning trades out of 238 trades turns net uninvested return from +7.43% to -9.32%.

4. Walk-Forward Inconsistency & Holdout Contamination: Only 4 of 6 walk-forward sub-windows produced positive uninvested net returns, and the 2025-04 -> 2026-11 OOS period was repeatedly inspected across Prompts 2-7.
